content.thinking: The deploy at 09:16 lines up exactly with the onset, and the cache port is set to 6380 instead of the correct 6379 — this looks like a config-induced failure, since the cache hit ratio drops to zero and p50 latency jumps to ~190ms while the error rate stays flat, pointing to a misconfigured redirect rather than an actual outage. I'm noting the specific subject (redis://cache.io-shop.svc.cluster.local:6380) and the deploy revision change from 544cef... to 0d8e82... as evidence, and thinking about what else to check to confirm this.
